crossRefs.note: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.
“Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?
If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.
Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.
if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.
What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us…

translations.web: If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
translations.bsb: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?
translations.kjv: If thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?
translations.asv: If thou, Jehovah, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?
